--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,46 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2-dimensional array")
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must have finite values")
+        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must have nonpositive values")
+        if arr.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("All log probability arrays must have the same shape")
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative scalar")
+    if not (np.isfinite(tau_filter) and tau_filter >= 0):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
+    
+    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
+    if future_horizon == 0:
+        raise ValueError("Future horizon must be positive")
+    
+    # Compute decreasing future-token weights
+    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
+    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
+    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
+    if weight_sum == 0:
+        normalized_weights = np.ones(future_horizon) / future_horizon
+    else:
+        normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum
+    
+    # Compute weighted margin
+    weighted_with_result = np.sum(logp_with_result * normalized_weights[np.newaxis, :], axis=1)
+    weighted_no_call = np.sum(logp_no_call * normalized_weights[np.newaxis, :], axis=1)
+    margin = weighted_with_result - weighted_no_call
+    
+    # Keep if margin exceeds threshold
+    keep_mask = margin > tau_filter
+    
+    return keep_mask.astype(bool), margin.astype(float)
